Operator actions are constrained by design tokens (colors, fonts) and governance rules (claims, safety). The failure mode occurs when any check fails: asset is modified or claim removed. The workflow is non-autonomous; all outputs undergo manual review. AI assistance is limited to drafting and scanning, not decision-making. The system enforces a dualism between creative freedom and regulatory compliance.
